source.author: stat
source.text: sic erecta genas aciemque offusa trementi sanguine desertam rabidis clamoribus urbem exagitat, clausasque domos et limina pulsans concilium vocat; infelix comitatus eunti haerebant nati.
source.text_original: sic erecta genas aciemque offusa trementi / sanguine desertam rabidis clamoribus urbem / exagitat, clausasque domos et limina pulsans / concilium vocat; infelix comitatus eunti / haerebant nati.
source.text_english: So, with cheeks raised and her eyes overcast with trembling blood, she rouses the deserted city with frantic cries; beating at shut houses and thresholds, she summons an assembly. Her unhappy children clung to her as she went.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: nostris modo concitus ausis aequoreos vocat ecce deos Neptunus et ingens concilium.
reuse.text_original: nostris modo concitus ausis / aequoreos vocat ecce deos Neptunus et ingens / concilium.
reuse.text_english: Just now, stirred by our daring, behold Neptune calls the sea gods and the great council.
